deploy-bot: :rocket: Starting deploy to prod
- env: prod
- release: release-1.3.5
- tag: v1.3.5
- commit: a1b2c3d4e5f6
- author: liam
- strategy: rolling (10% -> 100%)
- CI: <https://ci.internal/job/123|job/123>

jess: watching the rollout, ping me on any spike :eyes:

sam: seeing a small spike in 5xxs on /api/generate at +2m, alert threshold hit (4% error rate) — https://grafana.internal/d/xyz

tara: can we pause the rollout? oncall reported timeouts to support. @deploy-bot pause? :rotating_light:

jess: pausing traffic not possible in the middle of rolling, initiating rollback instead — we have to revert to the last known-good.

jess: /revert release-1.3.4 --reason "5xx spike + latency regression" --pin-duration 24h
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by jess. Starting revert deploy to prod:
- target release: release-1.3.4
- commit: z9y8x7w6v5u4
- scope: full revert across prod pools
- estimated time: ~5m
- incident link: https://incidents.internal/INC-5478

ops-oncall: I'll watch logs and clear alerts after rollback completes. Attaching tail of failing logs to the ticket.

deploy-bot: Rollback progress: 30% -> 60% -> 100% applied.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed :white_check_mark:
- status: success
- active_release: release-1.3.4 (commit z9y8x7w6v5u4)
- duration: 5m12s
- post-deploy health: 2xx rate restored to 99.8%, error rate back below threshold
- metrics: https://grafana.internal/d/xyz?var-release=release-1.3.4

jess: confirmed, errors cleared. Pinning prod to release-1.3.4 for 24h and cancelling the scheduled progressive rollout for 1.3.5. We'll triage in ENG-RUNTIME and ENG-ML.

sam: opening investigation ticket INC-5478 with heap dumps and traces, assigning to eng-runtime. Adding logs and the failing request IDs.

tara: notifying support and product to update status page and customer comms.

deploy-bot: Revert recorded in release history and release-notes: <https://releases.internal/release-1.3.5/revert|revert details>. Notifying #product and #support.

jess: follow-up actions: 1) investigate root cause, 2) create a smaller canary with extra telemetry before any re-rollout, 3) lock the deploy pipeline until a hotfix is approved.

ops-oncall: thanks everyone — closing the thread once the INC ticket has initial triage. :thumbsup:
